\newcommand\Perc{\%}

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# One-way repeated measures: a single within-subject factor (Day).
# The single pairwise table is carried in params$pairwise_Treatment.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

pairwise_Day <- as.data.frame(params$pairwise_Treatment)

char      <- params$char
mcp       <- params$mcp
pair_wise <- isTRUE(params$pair_wise)

has_rows <- function(x) {
  !is.null(x) && is.data.frame(x) && nrow(x) > 0
}

# Clean HTML superscript and symbols for PDF output
clean_latex_table <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df)) return(df)
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- gsub("<sup>", "$\\\\textsuperscript{", x)
    x <- gsub("</sup>", "}$", x)
    x <- gsub("<br>|</br>|<br/>", " \\\\ ", x)
    x <- gsub("&plusmn;|±", "$\\\\pm$", x)
    x <- gsub("%", "\\\\%", x)
    x <- gsub("&", "\\\\&", x)
    x
  })
  colnames(df) <- gsub("%", "\\\\Perc", colnames(df))
  colnames(df) <- gsub("_", ".", colnames(df))
  rownames(df) <- gsub("%", "\\\\Perc", rownames(df))
  rownames(df) <- gsub("_", ".", rownames(df))
  df
}

# Clean HTML superscript for Word output
replace_superscripts <- function(text) {
  text <- as.character(text)
  text <- gsub("<sup>\\*\\*</sup>", "**", text)
  text <- gsub("<sup>\\*</sup>", "*", text)
  # Trim spaces inside the tag so pandoc renders ^a^ (a real superscript) and
  # not a literal ^ a ^ (pandoc needs no space between the carets).
  text <- gsub("<sup>[[:space:]]*([^<]*[^[:space:]<])[[:space:]]*</sup>", "^\\1^", text)
  text <- gsub("<sup>\\s*</sup>", "", text)
  text <- gsub("<br>|</br>|<br/>", "\n", text)
  text <- gsub("&plusmn;", "±", text)
  text
}

clean_word_table <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df)) return(df)
  df[] <- lapply(df, replace_superscripts)
  df
}

# Generic table printer
print_table <- function(df, caption, table_no = NULL) {
  if (!has_rows(df)) return(invisible(NULL))
  full_caption <- if (!is.null(table_no)) paste0("Table ", table_no, ": ", caption) else caption

  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    tbl <- df %>%
      kableExtra::kbl(
        caption = full_caption,
        align = "c",
        escape = FALSE,
        row.names = FALSE
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = "bordered",
        full_width = FALSE,
        latex_options = "booktabs"
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_classic(full_width = FALSE)
    cat(tbl)
    cat("<br><br>")
  }

  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    df_latex <- clean_latex_table(df)
    tbl <- df_latex %>%
      kableExtra::kbl(
        caption = full_caption,
        format = "latex",
        escape = FALSE,
        align = "c",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        linesep = "",
        row.names = FALSE
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        position = "center",
        latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header", "scale_down", "H"),
        full_width = FALSE
      )
    print(tbl)
  }

  if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) {
    df_word <- clean_word_table(df)
    tbl <- df_word %>%
      knitr::kable(
        caption = full_caption,
        align = "c",
        row.names = FALSE,
        escape = FALSE
      )
    print(tbl)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}

if (has_rows(pairwise_Day)) {
  cat("## Pairwise comparison report for ", char, "\n\n", sep = "")

  if (!is.null(mcp) && !is.na(mcp)) {
    cat("**Multiple comparison procedure:** ", mcp, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }

  cat("This report presents pairwise comparisons for the Day (within-subject) factor. The table shows estimated differences, SE(d), degrees of freedom, t ratio, p value with significance mark, and CD value.\n\n")

  print_table(
    pairwise_Day,
    paste("Pairwise Comparison of Days for", char),
    table_no = 1
  )

  cat("\n\n**Significance notation:** `**` = significant at 1% level; `*` = significant at 5% level; `NS` = non-significant.\n\n")
  cat("**Abbreviations:** SE(d) = Standard error of difference; DF = Degrees of freedom; CD = Critical difference.\n\n")
  ## ##arshi(15-08-26) rounding note - significance comes from the model, not from the CD column
  cat("**Note:** Significance shown in the table above is computed from the fitted model at full precision; it is not obtained by comparing the estimates against the rounded CD value. The CD values shown are rounded to the number of decimal places selected in the app.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("No pairwise comparison table was supplied to the report. Please check the `params` list passed from Shiny.\n")
}

```
